batches.title: Batch-Boiled Eggs for the Week (Mon–Thu)
steps: 1. Place 14 eggs in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water by at least 2 cm.
2. Bring to a full rolling boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium and cook exactly 9 minutes (fully hard-boiled for safe storage).
3. Drain immediately and transfer eggs to a bowl of ice-cold water. Leave 5 minutes.
4. Peel all 14 eggs under running water. Pat dry with kitchen paper.
5. Place peeled eggs in an airtight container. Label: 'Boiled Eggs — use by Thursday'. Refrigerate.
6. Safety note: hard-boiled peeled eggs keep safely 4 days in the fridge (through Thursday = day 4 ✓).
yields: 14 peeled hard-boiled eggs — 2 per person per breakfast day (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday = 6 days × 2 persons = 12 used; 2 extra for Thursday lunch chickpea bowl)

day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Breakfast — Kefir & Banana Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough: retrieve 2 eggs each, toast sourdough, spread Greek yogurt, halve eggs on top.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Breakfast — Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado: retrieve 2 eggs each, toast sourdough, slice avocado on top of eggs.
day_of_assembly.Thursday: Breakfast — Kefir & Banana Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough with Olive Oil: retrieve 2 eggs each, toast sourdough, drizzle olive oil, dust with oregano. Also use 2 eggs each for Lunch — Chickpea Bowl: add cold halved eggs as protein topping.

storage.safety_note: Hard-boiled eggs: 1 week in shell, 5 days peeled in water. Scrambled/cooked dishes: 3–4 days.
